## Project Setup Instructions for Next.js

This repository contains a Next.js project setup for deployment to Vercel alongside database query scripts and configurations.

### Project Structure
- `/nextjs-website/` - Next.js application ready for Vercel deployment
- `/Postgresql/` - PostgreSQL database queries and scripts
- `/laravel/` - Laravel application examples
- Other database and development tools

### Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for type safety
- Follow Next.js 14 app router conventions
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling
- Ensure Vercel deployment compatibility
- Keep database queries separate from web application
